(function(){var out=[];Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('svg')).forEach(function(s,si){var ts=Array.from(s.querySelectorAll('text'));for(var i=0;i<ts.length;i++){for(var j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){var a=ts[i].getBBox(),b=ts[j].getBBox();var w=Math.min(a.x+a.width,b.x+b.width)-Math.max(a.x,b.x);var h=Math.min(a.y+a.height,b.y+b.height)-Math.max(a.y,b.y);if(w>2&&h>2)out.push(si+':'+ts[i].textContent+' <> '+ts[j].textContent)}}});return out.join(' | ')||'no text overlap'})()
